description: This file defines the 'Compact' formatter class for the SCSSPHP library, which formats SCSS output in a compact style. It is marked as deprecated and extends the base Formatter class.

classes.name: ScssPhp\ScssPhp\Formatter\Compact
classes.description: A formatter class that outputs compact formatted SCSS code, marked as deprecated in favor of the 'Compressed' formatter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes formatting properties and triggers a deprecation warning.

methods.name: indentStr
methods.description: Returns a single space string used for indentation in the compact formatting style.
